params.name: XY pad X position
params.desc: Horizontal position of the preset XY pad

params.name: XY pad Y position
params.desc: Vertical position of the preset XY pad

params.name: High-pass cutoff
params.desc: Cutoff of the non-resonant high-pass filter, placed before the low-pass filter (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Low-pass cutoff
params.desc: Cutoff of the resonant low-pass filter, also modulated by the envelope and velocity (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Resonance
params.desc: Resonance of the low-pass filter, self-resonating at maximum (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Rise time of the ADSR envelope (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Decay
params.desc: Fall time to the sustain level (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Sustain
params.desc: Level held while the touch or gate is held (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Release
params.desc: Fall time from sustain to silence after release (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Glide
params.desc: Portamento time between notes, instant at 0 (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Pitch
params.desc: Fine tune offset (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Octave
params.desc: Octave offset, plus or minus 5 octaves (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Sub oscillator / noise
params.desc: Bipolar source control, noise below centre, pitch-tracking sub oscillator above centre (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Wavefold / saturation
params.desc: Bipolar drive control, tape saturation below centre, wavefolding above centre (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Stereo spread
params.desc: Stereo position of the voice (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Delay send
params.desc: Post-fader send to the global tape delay (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Reverb send
params.desc: Post-fader send to the global reverb (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Toad factor
params.desc: Pitch-tracking sample rate reducer (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Volume
params.desc: Level of the voice, before master volume (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Timestretch
params.desc: Bipolar timestretch without pitch change; minimum freezes the sample into a wavetable (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Sample start
params.desc: Start point of the sample; acts as wavetable position when timestretch is frozen (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Sample length
params.desc: Length of the sample played from the start point (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Chorus / wobble
params.desc: Bipolar effect control, random pitch wobble below centre, stereo chorus above centre (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: Sidechain amount
params.desc: Bipolar sidechain control, duck receive below centre, sidechain send above centre (low value at the current XY position)

params.name: High-pass cutoff range
params.desc: Width of the random range for high-pass cutoff at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Low-pass cutoff range
params.desc: Width of the random range for low-pass cutoff at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Resonance range
params.desc: Width of the random range for resonance at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Attack range
params.desc: Width of the random range for attack at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Decay range
params.desc: Width of the random range for decay at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Sustain range
params.desc: Width of the random range for sustain at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Release range
params.desc: Width of the random range for release at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Glide range
params.desc: Width of the random range for glide at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Pitch range
params.desc: Width of the random range for pitch at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Octave range
params.desc: Width of the random range for octave at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Sub oscillator / noise range
params.desc: Width of the random range for sub oscillator / noise at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Wavefold / saturation range

params.name: Toad factor range
params.desc: Width of the random range for toad factor at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Volume range
params.desc: Width of the random range for volume at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Timestretch range
params.desc: Width of the random range for timestretch at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Sample start range
params.desc: Width of the random range for sample start at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Sample length range
params.desc: Width of the random range for sample length at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Chorus / wobble range
params.desc: Width of the random range for chorus / wobble at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Sidechain amount range
params.desc: Width of the random range for sidechain amount at the current XY position (high value minus low value)

params.name: Bass EQ / compressor
params.desc: Level of the low band (20 Hz to 125 Hz) of the master EQ and multiband compressor

params.name: Mid EQ / compressor
params.desc: Level of the mid band (125 Hz to 2.5 kHz) of the master EQ and multiband compressor

params.name: Treble EQ / compressor
params.desc: Level of the high band (2.5 kHz to 20 kHz) of the master EQ and multiband compressor

params.name: Tape dry
params.desc: Dry level of the internal tape (synth) voices

params.name: Audio in dry
params.desc: Dry level of the external audio input

params.name: Tape delay send
params.desc: Send from the synth voices to the tape delay

params.name: Tape reverb send
params.desc: Send from the synth voices to the reverb

params.name: Audio in delay send
params.desc: Send from the external audio input to the tape delay

params.name: Audio in reverb send
params.desc: Send from the external audio input to the reverb

params.name: Reverb shimmer
params.desc: Octave-shifted feedback in the reverb

params.name: Reverb feedback
params.desc: Reverb feedback, acting like a size control

params.name: Delay time
params.desc: Delay time, quantised to musical divisions and synced to the clock

params.name: Delay feedback
params.desc: Number of delay repeats

params.name: Reverb return
params.desc: Reverb return level

params.name: Delay return
params.desc: Delay return level

params.name: Output level
params.desc: Master output level at the audio jack and over USB

params.name: Audio in sidechain
params.desc: Sidechain amount applied from the external audio input

params.name: Reverb sidechain
params.desc: Sidechain amount applied to the reverb

params.name: Delay sidechain
params.desc: Sidechain amount applied to the delay

params.name: Bass EQ / compressor range
params.desc: Width of the random range for bass eq / compressor at the current XY position

params.name: Mid EQ / compressor range
params.desc: Width of the random range for mid eq / compressor at the current XY position

params.name: Treble EQ / compressor range
params.desc: Width of the random range for treble eq / compressor at the current XY position

params.name: Tape dry range
params.desc: Width of the random range for tape dry at the current XY position

params.name: Audio in dry range
params.desc: Width of the random range for audio in dry at the current XY position

params.name: Tempo
params.desc: Song tempo

params.name: Raw XY position X
params.desc: Raw X position of the XY pad

params.name: Raw XY position Y
params.desc: Raw Y position of the XY pad

params.usage: 0: No effect; 1-127: Request full state dump

params.desc: 12-bit pitch-class mask of the chord scale relative to the chord root
